content: My lower back hurts after deadlifts, should I keep going?

Safety first, Alex. Sharp or persistent pain means stop and see a professional—don't push through that. If it's mild soreness, lower the load and stay within a pain-free range of motion, focusing on form over weight. Deadlifts demand solid technique; even slight form breakdowns under fatigue can wreck your lower back. Get checked out if it doesn't settle in a day or two. 💪
